notes: 59 ABI functions plus the fallback reviewed; the whole text (1,040 lines) read. Most functions are thin wrappers that DELEGATECALL the linked libraries, so the source loops the pack lists (BTCUtils, BitcoinTx, ValidateSPV, DepositSweep, MovingFunds, Redemption, Fraud, BytesLib, Bank, RebateStaking) run in other code and are not in this bytecode: source_loops = 0. The 6 whiles are implicit validating decodes of uint32[]/bytes20[] calldata arrays (readable, not P7). Inlined library code checked against the source: Wallets.notifyWalletClosingPeriodElapsed (uint32 overflow check of closingStartedAt + walletClosingPeriod, state 3 -> 4, event, closeWallet call), the update*Parameters validations, the three initializers (OZ initializer/reinitializer flag handling), the gas-refund arithmetic of submitMovingFundsCommitment. No semantic error found. Event names are raw topics (not in the signature DB).
summary: Small and faithful: wrappers forward to unlinked libraries with correct arguments; the main problems are a hard-coded mapping element shown as two unrelated storage variables, packed slots left unsplit (slot 68, initialize's constants) and unsigned '<= 0' tests.
